pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:0.6: ime kho panayyāyo sekhiyā dhammā uddesaṃ āgacchanti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambantā nivāsenti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambantā nivāsessanti seyyathāpi gihiniyo kāmabhoginiyoti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.5: assosuṃ kho bhikkhuniyo tesaṃ manussānaṃ ujjhāyantānaṃ khīyantānaṃ vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.6: yā tā bhikkhuniyo appicchā …pe… tā ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.7: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambantā nivāsessantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.8: saccaṃ kira bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambantā nivāsentīti.
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.11: hi nāma bhikkhave chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo puratopi pacchatopi olambantā nivāsessanti
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.13: evañca pana bhikkhave bhikkhuniyo imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddisantu
pli-tv-bi-vb-sk1:1.16: yā anādariyaṃ paṭicca purato vā pacchato vā olambantā nivāseti āpatti dukkaṭassa.
